description: This Java class implements a substitution strategy for modifying policy headers in a policy modification command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It applies header-based substitutions to policies encapsulated by the ModifyPolicy command.

classes.name: ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy to perform header-based modifications on ModifyPolicy commands.

methods.name: ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that sets the class to handle ModifyPolicy objects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs the substitution on the given ModifyPolicy using a provided substitution algorithm, returning a new modified ModifyPolicy or the original if no changes are needed.
